purpose: Historical thesis Oracle/RL reference values used to explain frozen replay and fresh retraining outputs.

comparison_policy.prohibited_use: Do not tune toward the reference. A mismatch must be investigated as code, input, environment, or stochastic-checkpoint lineage drift.

frozen_replay.description: Exact replay contract for restored thesis Stage3-5 frozen checkpoints/artifacts.
frozen_replay.interpretation_boundary: Use only with the packaged historical Stage3, Stage4, and Stage5 artifacts.

fresh_retrain.description: Fresh-training contract for a newly trained Stage3-5 lineage from the packaged Stage2 substrate.
fresh_retrain.interpretation_boundary: The no-op anchors remain hard checks of the 575-firm cohort and Oracle/evaluator substrate. Historical Candidate-IQL point differences are recorded as checkpoint-lineage drift and do not alone fail a fresh stochastic retraining. This mode does not claim frozen-checkpoint point parity.

frozen_rl_lineage.source: original thesis_repo frozen Stage3-5 artifacts supplied for forensic comparison on 2026-07-20
